The other three A's split the remaining 8 non-A positions into four positive gaps l1+l2+l3+l4=8. Inside each gap, B and C must alternate. If q of the four gaps have odd length, then balancing B and C requires q/2 of those odd gaps to start with B. Thus for a gap composition with q odd gaps, the number of fillings is C(q,q/2) 2^(4-q). For an edge-midpoint-axis reflection, each axis swaps the endpoints of an edge, forcing two adjacent beads to have the same color, which is forbidden. So these 6 reflections fix 0 colorings.

Reflection fixed-point sum: 144.

(840 + 144) / 24 = 984 / 24 = 41.

Therefore the exact number of distinct necklaces is 41.
